description.value: A layer of ash and grime is as good as a cloak if you know how to wear it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Sneak while in ashfall, smoke, or heavy dust, treating it as concealment even where it technically isn't.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +1 circumstance bonus to Sneak is gated on 'while in ashfall, smoke, or heavy dust', an environmental condition with no roll-option hook: pf2e's terrain roll options come from a closed environmentTypes enum (aquatic/arctic/desert/forest/mountain/plains/swamp/underground/urban; pf2e-source/src/module/scene/region-behavior/environment.ts:16-20, StringField choices restricted to that list) that has none of Cinderfall's wasteland terrain, and there is no GM-facing way to add to it. Real Rock Runner's own terrain:stone/terrain:earth predicate values aren't in that enum either, confirming this is a closed system, not a GM-extensible one. The 'treat it as concealment even where it technically isn't' clause has no hook either -- concealment is derived from actual scene conditions, not grantable by a passive rule element.
